protocol.jaccard_penalty: 0.5 * global score-rank quality + 0.5 * (1 - maximum pairwise Jaccard)
protocol.marginal_coverage: 0.5 * global score-rank quality + 0.5 * newly covered node fraction
protocol.deployment_rule: hard_disjoint is fixed before label inspection because the compression index rejects any shared region node; relaxed methods are diagnostics only
protocol.individual_label_warning: mean region gains are single-region labels and are not additive combined-index gains
